changelog:
v4.2.14 — "Send Debug Log" now tells us why the app closed

• If the app ever closes on its own, it now records the reason — which screen you were on, how long the app had been open, and how much memory was free — and keeps that record until you send it to us.

• Before this, that information was stored in a file that got overwritten as you kept watching, so reports from people whose app was closing often arrived with nothing in them. If the app has been shutting down on you, please send a debug log from Settings and we'll finally be able to see the cause.

• No change to playback or picture quality.

Includes everything from v4.2.13: the fix for shows freezing mid-episode on Dolby titles, season and episode numbers on every screen, and the new logo.
